value.rationale: The exact demographic crossover at the homophily ratio is motivated by competing group size and assortative social influence and occurs for all complementary but arbitrarily opposed starting opinions. The critical inverse-seed waiting time adds a sharp, nontrivial time-scale law that explains long transients at the boundary. The theorem solves a natural global-versus-local question in a published social model; its biological/empirical predictive scope is explicitly limited.
